scares.description: Kate sees John in the mirror.
There is a flash of lightning and Esther can be seen standing over Max’s bed.
John sees Esther watching while he and Kate are having sex in the kitchen.
A child jumps out in front of Brenda on the playground.
Esther suddenly appears and pushes Brenda off the slide.
Sister Abigail bends down to check on Max which reveals Esther standing behind her.
Esther appears with the hammer as Abigail is crawling away.
Esther’s hand, holding a box cutter, appears beside Danny while he is sleeping.
Esther jumps out from under the covers to scare John.
Esther runs at Kate and Max.
Esther grabs Kate’s leg as she is crawling out of the hole in the ice.
